short_scope: out-of-plane5x5mm conducting short absorbs particles; feed and exterior escapes recorded; full3D field fringing not resolved
space_charge_model: height-averaged2D Poisson with3D particle transport and imposed linear axial voltage profile
voltage_model: midpoint pulse half of220kV feed pulse; ideal linear axial drop to0atshort; symmetric scalar longitudinal gradient plus native inductive Ez
initial_electrons: empty at first supported heating timestamp; prior electron population unknown
thermal_source: 295 high resolution upper boundary states; mirrored lower reconstruction verified on small case
fields: linear temporal interpolation of coarse regenerated native Az curl and inductive Ez; conditional AK voltage
source_law: patch Richardson phi4.3eV ideal A, no Schottky or tunneling
source_reservoir: sub-electron face supplies accumulated before emission; less than one physical electron per face/electrode can be delayed
step_rule: gyroangle<=0.05, dt<=10fs with particles, plasma-frequency and particle-displacement limits; empty vacuum<=1ps
limitations: constant-property heating beyond material validity; no phase change, collisions, gas feedback or sheath/grid convergence
checkpoint_format: same frozen executable ABI only; input SHA checked by launcher
parallelism: root particles/assembly/output; one CPU rank; optional CUDA cuDSS field solve
